network_profile.description: Desktop runtime E4 accepts P0|P1|P2; P3–P6 reserved (fail-closed in runtime).

open_ui_on_start.description: Open native status/settings UI after successful start.

autostart_on_login.description: OS login autostart; hooks owned by tray (#78), default false.

http_listen.description: Fixed host:port for aira-node HTTP. No hidden auto-increment; conflict → fail or attach.

instance_id.description: Stable per-install id for single-instance attach semantics.

http_auth_mode.description: Desktop auth contract placeholder; token generation / IPC are #76.

http_token_ref.description: Path or ref to token secret file (not the secret). Placeholder when http_auth_mode=bearer_token.

peer_listen.description: Peer listen host:port. Unused/null on P0; required for P1 (runtime default 127.0.0.1:9797).
